```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(R2jags)
library(coda)
library(patchwork)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")
study_1_path <- file.path(main_path, "study_1")
results_path <- file.path(study_1_path, "results")
models_path <- file.path(main_path, "models")
figure_path <- file.path(study_1_path, "figures")

set.seed(7386)

demographics <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "demographics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
prisoner_long <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "prisoner_dilemma_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
sound_events <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "sound_events.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

source(file.path(main_path, "overall_functions.R"))
```

```{r}
dem_analytic <- demographics %>%
  filter(
    !excluded,
    setup == "COOP"
  )

analytic_ids <- dem_analytic %>%
  distinct(id)

prisoner_long <- prisoner_long %>%
  filter(setup == "COOP") %>%
  semi_join(
    analytic_ids,
    by = "id"
  )

sound_analytic <- sound_events %>%
  filter(setup == "COOP") %>%
  semi_join(
    analytic_ids,
    by = "id"
  )
```

```{r}
participant_press_summary <- sound_analytic %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    female_press_count =
      sum(responder_gender == "Female", na.rm = TRUE),

    male_press_count =
      sum(responder_gender == "Male", na.rm = TRUE),

    no_press_count =
      sum(responder_gender == "none", na.rm = TRUE),

    total_dyad_presses =
      female_press_count + male_press_count,

    n_sound_events = n(),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      female_press_count,
      male_press_count
    ),
    names_to = "gender",
    values_to = "own_press_count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gender = recode(
      gender,
      female_press_count = "Female",
      male_press_count = "Male"
    ),

    partner_press_count =
      total_dyad_presses - own_press_count,

    relative_press_count =
      own_press_count - partner_press_count,

    own_never_pressed =
      as.integer(own_press_count == 0),

    partner_never_pressed =
      as.integer(partner_press_count == 0),

    neither_pressed =
      as.integer(total_dyad_presses == 0)
  )
```

```{r}
prisoner_long <- prisoner_long %>%
  mutate(
    cooperation = case_when(
      decision == "Cooperate" ~ 1L,
      decision == "Defect"    ~ 0L,
      TRUE                    ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

prisoner_partner <- prisoner_long %>%
  dplyr::select(
    id,
    round_number,
    id_in_group,
    partner_code = participant.code,
    partner_gender = gender,
    partner_cooperation = cooperation,
    partner_decision = decision,
    partner_pay_off = pay_off
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    id_in_group = case_when(
      id_in_group == 1 ~ 2,
      id_in_group == 2 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

prisoner_long <- prisoner_long %>%
  left_join(
    prisoner_partner,
    by = c("id", "round_number", "id_in_group")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    round_outcome = case_when(
      cooperation == 1 & partner_cooperation == 1 ~ "CC",
      cooperation == 1 & partner_cooperation == 0 ~ "CD",
      cooperation == 0 & partner_cooperation == 1 ~ "DC",
      cooperation == 0 & partner_cooperation == 0 ~ "DD",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    dyad_outcome = case_when(
      round_outcome == "CC" ~ "Mutual cooperation",
      round_outcome == "DD" ~ "Mutual defection",
      round_outcome %in% c("CD", "DC") ~ "Asymmetric",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

```

```{r}
prisoner_model_data <- prisoner_long %>%
  left_join(
    participant_press_summary,
    by = c("id", "gender")
  )

mean_total_dyad_presses <- participant_press_summary %>%
  distinct(id, total_dyad_presses) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_total = mean(total_dyad_presses)
  ) %>%
  pull(mean_total)

prisoner_model_data <- prisoner_model_data %>%
  mutate(
    total_dyad_presses_c =
      total_dyad_presses - mean_total_dyad_presses,

    gender = factor(
      gender,
      levels = c("Female", "Male")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
prisoner_participant_summary <- prisoner_long %>%
  group_by(
    setup,
    id,
    participant.code,
    id_in_group,
    gender,
    position
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rounds = sum(!is.na(cooperation)),
    n_cooperate = sum(cooperation == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_defect = sum(cooperation == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    cooperation_prop = mean(cooperation, na.rm = TRUE),

    n_mutual_cooperation = sum(round_outcome == "CC", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_exploited = sum(round_outcome == "CD", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_exploited_partner = sum(round_outcome == "DC", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_mutual_defection = sum(round_outcome == "DD", na.rm = TRUE),

    total_payoff = sum(pay_off, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_payoff = mean(pay_off, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(id, id_in_group)

print(prisoner_participant_summary, n = 98)
```

```{r}
prisoner_dyad_summary <- prisoner_long %>%
  group_by(setup, id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n_distinct(participant.code),
    n_rounds = n_distinct(round_number),
    n_decisions = sum(!is.na(cooperation)),

    n_cooperate = sum(cooperation == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_defect = sum(cooperation == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    cooperation_prop = mean(cooperation, na.rm = TRUE),

    total_dyad_payoff = sum(pay_off, na.rm = TRUE),
    combined_payoff_per_round =
      sum(pay_off, na.rm = TRUE) / n_distinct(round_number),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    prisoner_long %>%
      filter(id_in_group == 1) %>%
      group_by(setup, id) %>%
      summarise(
        mutual_cooperation_rounds =
          sum(dyad_outcome == "Mutual cooperation", na.rm = TRUE),

        asymmetric_rounds =
          sum(dyad_outcome == "Asymmetric", na.rm = TRUE),

        mutual_defection_rounds =
          sum(dyad_outcome == "Mutual defection", na.rm = TRUE),

        mutual_cooperation_prop =
          mean(dyad_outcome == "Mutual cooperation", na.rm = TRUE),

        asymmetric_prop =
          mean(dyad_outcome == "Asymmetric", na.rm = TRUE),

        mutual_defection_prop =
          mean(dyad_outcome == "Mutual defection", na.rm = TRUE),

        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("setup", "id")
  ) %>%
  arrange(id)

print(prisoner_dyad_summary, n = 49)
```

```{r}
prisoner_round_individual_summary


prisoner_round_dyad_summary <- prisoner_long %>%
  filter(id_in_group == 1) %>%
  count(
    setup,
    round_number,
    dyad_outcome,
    name = "n_dyads"

  group_by(setup, round_number) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = n_dyads / sum(n_dyads)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(round_number, dyad_outcome)

    proportion
```

```{r}
pd_gender_difference <- prisoner_participant_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(
    id,
    gender,
    n_cooperate,
    cooperation_prop
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = gender,
    values_from = c(n_cooperate, cooperation_prop)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cooperation_count_diff_female_male =
      n_cooperate_Female - n_cooperate_Male,

    cooperation_prop_diff_female_male =
      cooperation_prop_Female - cooperation_prop_Male
  )
```

```{r}
pd_gender_difference %>%
  count(
    cooperation_count_diff_female_male,
    sort = FALSE
  )

pd_gender_difference %>%
  summarise(
    n_dyads = n(),
    mean_difference =
      mean(cooperation_count_diff_female_male),
    sd_difference =

    median_difference =
      median(cooperation_count_diff_female_male),
    min_difference =
      min(cooperation_count_diff_female_male),
    max_difference =
      max(cooperation_count_diff_female_male),
    n_equal =
      sum(cooperation_count_diff_female_male == 0),
    prop_equal =
      mean(cooperation_count_diff_female_male == 0)
  )
```

```{r}
p_pd_cooperation_round <- prisoner_round_individual_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = round_number, y = cooperation_prop)) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.8,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2.5,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +

    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Prisoner’s Dilemma round",
    y = "Proportion cooperating"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

p_pd_dyad_outcomes <- prisoner_round_dyad_summary %>%
  mutate(
    dyad_outcome = factor(
      dyad_outcome,
      levels = c(
        "Mutual cooperation",
        "Asymmetric",
        "Mutual defection"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(x = round_number, y = proportion, colour = dyad_outcome, shape = dyad_outcome, group = dyad_outcome)
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Mutual cooperation" = "#5B9BD5",
      "Asymmetric" = "#C27AC0",
      "Mutual defection" = "#C58B6B")

    values = c(
      "Mutual cooperation" = 16,
      "Asymmetric" = 17,
      "Mutual defection" = 15

  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),

    x = "Prisoner’s Dilemma round",
    y = "Proportion of dyads",
    colour = "Dyad outcome",

  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_pd_combined <- p_pd_cooperation_round +

  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1), guides = "collect") +

  theme(
```

##########
Model: initial Prisoner's Dilemma cooperation
Was earlier button-press behavior associated with the participant's initial decision to cooperate with the same partner?
```{r}
#prepare data
pd_round1_data <- prisoner_model_data %>%
  filter(
    round_number == 1,
    !is.na(cooperation),
    !is.na(total_dyad_presses_c),
    !is.na(relative_press_count),
    !is.na(id)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dyad_index = as.integer(factor(id))
  ) %>%
  arrange(dyad_index, participant.code)

```

```{r}
### Correlation check between the two predictors
pd_round1_data %>%
  summarise(
    r = cor(
      total_dyad_presses_c,
      relative_press_count
    )
  )
```

```{r}
data_list_pd <- list(
  N = nrow(pd_round1_data),
  N_dyads =
    n_distinct(pd_round1_data$dyad_index),
  cooperation =
    as.integer(pd_round1_data$cooperation),
  total_dyad_presses_c =
    as.numeric(pd_round1_data$total_dyad_presses_c),
  relative_press_count =
    as.numeric(pd_round1_data$relative_press_count),
  dyad_index =
    as.integer(pd_round1_data$dyad_index))

str(data_list_pd)

params_pd <- c(
  # Posterior parameters
  "beta0",
  "beta_total",
  "beta_relative",
  "sigma_dyad",
  "p_reference",

  # Posterior predictive quantity
  "n_cooperate_rep",

  # Direct prior draws
  "beta0_prior",
  "beta_total_prior",
  "beta_relative_prior",
  "sigma_dyad_prior",

  # Prior predictive quantity
  "n_cooperate_prior"
)
```

```{r}
samples_path_pd <- file.path(
  results_path,
  "s1_jags_prisoners_dilemma_round1_logistic.rds")

if (file.exists(samples_path_pd)) {
  samples_pd <- readRDS(samples_path_pd)
  } else {
    samples_pd <- jags.parallel(
      data = data_list_pd,
      inits = NULL,
      parameters.to.save = params_pd,
  
      model.file = file.path(
        models_path,
        "s1_prisoners_dilemma_log_reg.bugs"
      ),
  
      n.chains = 12,
      n.iter = 25000,
      n.burnin = 5000,
      n.thin = 1)
  
    saveRDS(
      samples_pd,
      samples_path_pd)}

samples_pd

mcmc_pd <- as.mcmc(samples_pd)
s_pd <- as.matrix(mcmc_pd)
```

```{r}

p_total_positive
```

```{r}
# Bayes factors for H0: beta = 0 versus H1: beta ~ Normal(0, 0.25)

prior_density_zero <- dnorm(
  0,
  mean = 0,
  sd = 0.25
)

posterior_density_at_zero <- function(draws) {

  dens <- density(
    draws,
    n = 2^15
  )

  approx(
    x = dens$x,
    y = dens$y,
    xout = 0
  )$y
}

posterior_density_total_zero <-
  posterior_density_at_zero(
    s_pd[, "beta_total"]
  )

posterior_density_relative_zero <-
  posterior_density_at_zero(
    s_pd[, "beta_relative"]
  )

BF01_total <-
  posterior_density_total_zero /
  prior_density_zero

BF01_relative <-
  posterior_density_relative_zero /
  prior_density_zero

BF10_total <- 1 / BF01_total
BF10_relative <- 1 / BF01_relative

BF01_total
BF01_relative
BF10_total
BF10_relative
```

```{r}
plot_png_path <- file.path(
  figure_path,
  "s1_prisoners_dilemma_round1_logistic_traceplots.png"
)

if (!file.exists(plot_png_path)) {
  mcmc_list_pd <- as.mcmc(samples_pd)
  trace_df_pd <- purrr::map2_dfr(
    mcmc_list_pd,
    seq_along(mcmc_list_pd),
    ~ as.data.frame(.x) %>%
      rownames_to_column("iteration") %>%
      mutate(
        iteration = as.integer(iteration),
        chain = paste0("chain_", .y)
      )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      iteration,
      chain,
      beta0,
      beta_total,
      beta_relative,
      sigma_dyad
    ) %>%
    group_by(chain) %>%
    slice(seq(1, n(), by = 20)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(
        beta0,
        beta_total,
        beta_relative,
        sigma_dyad
      ),
      names_to = "parameter",
      values_to = "value")

  p_trace_pd <- ggplot(
    trace_df_pd,
    aes(
      x = iteration,
      y = value,
      colour = chain)) +
    geom_line(
      alpha = 0.6,
      linewidth = 0.25) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~parameter,
      scales = "free_y",
      ncol = 1) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Traceplots: first-round Prisoner’s Dilemma model",
      x = "Iteration",
      y = "Value",
      colour = "Chains")

  show_or_save_ggplot(
    plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
    plot_object = p_trace_pd,
    width = 8,
    height = 9,
    dpi = 300)
  } else {
    show_or_save_ggplot(
      plot_png_path = plot_png_path)
    }
```
